items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I got a chance to do some things for Decca Records, Gordon Jenkins

ctx.x: It just didn't work out. Then through '49 there wasn't very much there, except getting better. I got a chance to do some things for Decca Records, Gordon Jenkins, toward the end of '49. I thought I was going to get into the Decca crowd at that time, but that didn't work either. Then abruptly in '50 I got sick again.
What kind of things did you do for Decca?
